name: Private Client
insp: private banking and luxury hospitality sites
desc: Slow and silky, in deep blue and cream. The meeting photo moves like liquid under your cursor, the headline rises line by line inside a drawn cream frame, and Ranjana's portrait holds still while her credentials and the firm's own words pass in large serif.
fx: Hero photo ripples like liquid where your cursor moves, then settles
Headline lines rise through masks as a cream frame draws around the screen
Director portrait holds while her words scroll past in large serif
Services stack as opaque cards in blue, cream and green
Five promises slide sideways in a pinned strip
Leaders' portraits ripple on hover; award photo opens from the centre
